entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集说编码智能体已广泛使用,但每次会话都是空白上下文、零记忆,需要判断力被显式化,并要靠硬性闸门来约束——它们会找到甚至发明自我授权的例外。

evidence.quote: The agent boots with a blank context window and no memory every session.

evidence.quote: Every piece of judgment you picked up by osmosis, it has to be made explicit, or the agent simply never has it.

evidence.quote: It's that bundle written down so that the agent re-fires it instead of guessing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So new session, fresh agent, zero memory.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I came back to a half-finished presentation and a fresh agent read the work log and resumed exactly where I had left off.

evidence.quote: And the agent doesn't have to be right the first time.

evidence.quote: I give the agent its own QA.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The agent that wrote the code will always tell you that it works, so you make it hand back a recording of the thing actually running.

evidence.quote: I got tired of watching old feature flags pile up, so I built an agent for cleaning up stale feature flags.

evidence.quote: One hard lesson from my side projects, when you let an agent author the code, your guardrails are your code review.

evidence.quote: Never hand the agent a reason that it can grant itself.

evidence.quote: A flag agent, a dependency agent, an accessibility agent, each one is narrow, each with its own encoded judgment pointed at a different chore.

entities.name: harness 工程 (harness engineering)
entities.how_described: 本集的核心主张:工作已经变了,工程师现在是「harness 工程师」——构建生产和验证代码的系统(约束、闸门、技能、验证),「更少的产品工程,更多的 harness 工程」。

evidence.quote: That's harness engineering.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Less product engineering and more harness engineering.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 自动驾驶代码库 (self-driving codebase)
entities.how_described: 本集标题级概念:当判断力从人的头脑被显式化进代码库、由一群各自「在闸门处转到变绿」的狭窄专家智能体组成时,自动驾驶代码库就会涌现。

evidence.quote: That's the fleet, specialists, each spinning at its own gate, and a self-driving codebase emerges from the swarm.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A self-driving codebase is a system that keeps its own judgment current in addition to writing code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 技能 (skill)
entities.how_described: 本集三原语之一:把机构判断力变成可执行的东西,引用 Minsky 的 K 线;强调文档保存事实,而技能保存「哪些事实重要、哪些决策危险」的判断力。

evidence.quote: A skill is institutional judgment made executable.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So a skill is a K line for a code base.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A skill written for last month's architecture isn't out of date.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You run the post-mortem and fold the lesson back into the skill so that failure can't happen twice.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Don't just go write a skill.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 人设 (persona)
entities.how_described: 本集三原语之一,源自 Karpathy 推文:提示模型时别要观点、要视角;让模型以安全负责人、UX 研究员、马基雅维利等身份评审代码,按需加载自己不具备的判断力。

entities.how_described: 本集说当你让智能体写代码时,你的护栏就是你的代码审查——引出 pre-commit hook 与 OS 级闸门的教训。

evidence.quote: One hard lesson from my side projects, when you let an agent author the code, your guardrails are your code review.

entities.name: 心智社会 (Society of Mind)
entities.how_described: 本集引用 Minsky 的概念:一群小而简单的专家组合成顶层看起来毫不费力的东西,没有主宰大脑——自动驾驶代码库就是从这样的智能体机群中涌现。

evidence.quote: He called it the Society of Mind, a swarm of small, simple specialists that compose into something that looks effortless at the top, no master brain anywhere.
